admission_rule: every exact identity/shape must match; every sample must satisfy all absolute, RMS, cosine, and finite-count gates; greedy tokens must match unless listed in greedy_near_tie_exceptions

calibration.absolute_and_rms_margin: 1.10x then round upward to two significant digits
calibration.cosine_margin: 1.10x observed distance from 1 then floor to six decimals
calibration.relative_error: reported but not gated because near-zero denominators make maxima unstable
